manuscript.title: Chapter 1
manuscript.summary: Mr. Bingley, a wealthy single gentleman, rents Netherfield Park, exciting Mrs. Bennet who hopes he will marry one of her five daughters.

children.title: Netherfield Park is let at last
children.content:
It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.

However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighborhood, this truth is so well fixed in the minds of the surrounding families, that he is considered the rightful property of some one or other of their daughters.

manuscript.title: Chapter 2
manuscript.summary: Mr. Bennet visits Mr. Bingley in secret, surprising his family and demonstrating his affection for them.

children.title: We cannot escape the subject
children.content: Mr. Bennet was among the earliest of those who waited on Mr. Bingley. He had always intended to visit him, though to the last always assuring his wife that he should not go; and till the evening after the visit was paid she had no knowledge of it.

cards.title: Bingley Arrives
cards.content: Bingley rents Netherfield Park, exciting Mrs. Bennet.

cards.title: First Spark
cards.content: Jane and Bingley meet and there's immediate mutual interest.

cards.title: Mr. Bennet's Visit
cards.content: Mr. Bennet reveals he has visited Bingley, surprising the family.

characters.name: Elizabeth Bennet
characters.description: The second of the Bennet daughters. She is intelligent, lively, and quick-witted, but prone to forming quick judgments.

characters.name: Jane Bennet
characters.description: The eldest Bennet sister, sweet-tempered and beautiful, always thinking the best of everyone.

characters.name: Mr. Darcy
characters.description: A wealthy gentleman, proud and socially awkward initially, but highly honorable.

story_notes.title: Hertfordshire
story_notes.content: The county in Southern England where the Bennets and Bingleys live.

story_notes.title: Longbourn
story_notes.content: The Bennet family estate, entailed to Mr. Collins.

key_events.title: Mr. Bingley Rents Netherfield
key_events.description: The news of Netherfield being let to a wealthy bachelor spreads across Hertfordshire.
